authority: T0 exact finite staggered-factorization and causal-boundary certificate; not a TECT claim, tier change, CP1 completion, or Pre-A closure
statement: For every PA-CP1-LT3-RS-v0 lattice side N divisible by four, the signed parity-block map phi_(2y+epsilon)=(-1)^sum(y) psi_epsilon(y), with the same map on momentum, is an exact canonical signed permutation and factorizes the full nonlinear Hamiltonian into eight decoupled nearest-neighbour coarse phi4 Hamiltonians. Thus the eight fine Q nodes are zone-folded zero modes of eight real coarse species; the 256 parent minima and finite quantum tensor product follow as analytic corollaries of this factorization and the registered LT3 complete-square and finite-ground theorems. A newly declared spacing-dependent harmonic family, with a as the coarse spacing and inherited fine spacing a/2, has the fixed-band Klein-Gordon symbol limit and a global group-speed bound. After selecting one species, one axis and the transverse-zero sector and tuning c/chi=1 and -2r/chi=9, its ordered tangent on the exact PA-H1 circle of circumference pi/2 has squared frequencies 9,25,25. This is only a tuned tangent calibration. The continuous-time semidiscrete harmonic propagator has a nonzero nearest-neighbour t-squared response at arbitrarily small time, so bounded group speed does not give exact finite-regulator characteristic support. No characteristic reconstruction, state restriction, interacting or quantum continuum limit, physical empty-space comparison, CP1, or Pre-A closure follows.
verdict: ADVANCE THE EXACT STAGGERED FACTORIZATION AND HARMONIC CONTINUUM CALIBRATION; REJECT EXACT FINITE-LATTICE CHARACTERISTIC COMPLETION AND KEEP CP1 OPEN
